Subject: Invoice delivery & VAT capture questions

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the lower-latency benchmarks. Before we get the PO started, procurement has a few questions about how you deliver invoices and capture tax information:

- Can Redwood issue e-invoices (structured XML/UBL) that our AP system can ingest automatically, or do you only provide PDF invoices?
- If e-invoices are supported, is there a regular endpoint/FTP/SFTP we push to or do you push to us?
- For customers in the EU, can you capture VAT ID at billing time and show VAT line items?
- We prefer to set up a single billing contact and auto-apply POs. Is there a billing-contact onboarding form we can use?

Our timeline: need billing contact + initial invoice before our July 30 procurement cutoff.

Appreciate the quick clarification — looping in Marcus (CFO) and procure@brighthealth.ai.

Best,
Sara Hart
Head of Procurement
BrightHealth Analytics
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & VAT capture questions

Hi Sara — great to hear and glad the demo landed well. Short answers up front, then specifics and next steps.

- We support both: PDF invoices via email and structured e-invoice (UBL/PEPPOL-like payloads) for customers that need automated ingestion.
- Delivery options for e-invoices: we can push to an SFTP endpoint you provide, or integrate via a push webhook to a secure endpoint. For larger accounts we can also integrate with common e-invoicing hubs.
- VAT: yes, we capture VAT IDs at billing setup and show VAT as a separate line item. We also store tax jurisdiction info for recurring invoices.
- Billing contact onboarding: attached is a short billing_contact_form (Excel) and a sample PDF invoice so your AP can confirm field mapping.

Notes/constraints:
- E-invoice pushes require a small onboarding window (usually 5 business days) to validate test payloads.
- For card-on-file payments vs wire, we can support both; large enterprise deals commonly use ACH/wire with net-30 terms.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Fill the attached billing_contact_form with the AP contact and VAT ID.
2) Confirm whether you want PDF via email (standard) or automated e-invoice push.
3) If automated, share test SFTP details or a webhook URL and we’ll schedule a short onboarding call with finance ops.

I’ll also loop in Laura (Finance Ops) to prepare the invoice template and handle VAT configuration.

Thanks — I’m available for a quick call today or tomorrow if you prefer.

— Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
